title: Concentration effects and $Γ$-limit for the elastica functional for open and closed curves
summary: We study the $Γ$-convergence of a class of elastica-type energies defined on immersed planar curves and depending on a small positive parameter $ε$. As $ε\to 0^+$, sequences with equibounded energy develop concentration phenomena in the curvature, leading to the emergence of singularities described by atomic measures. This naturally gives rise to a limiting framework in terms of pointed curves, consisting of a curve together with a measure encoding curvature concentration.
